'''''Dusk in Kachirho''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] available<ref name="SWGpainting" /> sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which took place during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Note">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other|Opening Crawl}} places the events of the [[Star Wars video games|game]] after the destruction of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]], which occurred during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War's]] [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> It depicted the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Tree/Legends|tree]]-[[City/Legends|city]] of [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]] on<ref name="SWGpainting" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] while the [[Kashyyyk (star)/Legends|sun]] set.<ref name="SWGpainting" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Dusk in Kachirho'' was an obtainable painting in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment. The player could use the painting in their house as decoration.<ref name="SWGpainting" />

It was a reward for [[Wikipedia:Japanese people|Japanese]] players of the game to celebrate the first year anniversary of the release of the game in [[Wikipedia:Japan|Japan]].<ref name="SWGpainting" /> When the game was shut down there, players in that region were given the opportunity to migrate their characters to servers in [[Wikipedia:Europe|Europe]] and the [[Wikipedia:United States|United States]],<ref name="Japan">{{EA|subdomain=japan|url=swg/news.phtml?NEWS_ID=323|text="Star Wars Galaxy" Notice of suspension of paid service in Japan}}</ref> leading to a select few of these paintings becoming available on [[Wikipedia:Western world|Western]] servers and highly valuable.<ref name="SWGpainting" />

With the addition of the "[[W:c:swg:Rare Loot System|Rare Loot System]]" in [[W:c:swg:Hotfix 17.10|Hotfix 17.10]]<ref name="Hotfix">{{SonyCite|url=en_US/players/content.vm?page=Current%20update#gu1710|text=''Star Wars'' Galaxies: Hotfix 17.10}}</ref> on [[October 7]], [[2010]],<ref name="Hotfix 17">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68952&month=102010|text=Star Wars Galaxies: Hotfix 17.10 -- Thursday, October 7, 2010}}</ref> which allowed players to loot rare items from any enemy, the painting became less scarce as it was one of the items available through the system.<ref name="Hotfix" /> The game shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
